title: Care foregoing entry, exit, and persistence coincide with distinct 2025 adaptation surfaces

observations.period: 2024 to 2025; no listed cost-related care foregoing to no listed care foregoing

denominator.unit: recontacted respondents with complete E1_a-E1_e in both years

observations.method: Link 2024 and 2025 records by shedid; complete care fields in both years; any Yes among E1_a-E1_e defines foregoing; outcomes are 2025 values weighted by panel_weight.
observations.uncertainty: Longitudinal descriptive transition with no dated bill, causal order, remedy, or replicate-weight standard errors.
observations.counterinterpretation: No reported foregoing does not prove no unmet need or absence of health-cost pressure.

observations.period: 2024 to 2025; no listed cost-related care foregoing to any listed care foregoing

denominator.unit: recontacted respondents with complete E1_a-E1_e in both years

observations.method: Link 2024 and 2025 records by shedid; complete care fields in both years; any Yes among E1_a-E1_e defines foregoing; outcomes are 2025 values weighted by panel_weight.
observations.uncertainty: Longitudinal descriptive transition with no dated bill, causal order, remedy, or replicate-weight standard errors; entry cell is smaller.
observations.counterinterpretation: A newly reported care-foregoing status may reflect recall, changing need, access, or cost rather than a newly occurring bill.

observations.period: 2024 to 2025; any listed cost-related care foregoing to no listed care foregoing

denominator.unit: recontacted respondents with complete E1_a-E1_e in both years

observations.method: Link 2024 and 2025 records by shedid; complete care fields in both years; any Yes among E1_a-E1_e defines foregoing; outcomes are 2025 values weighted by panel_weight.
observations.uncertainty: Longitudinal descriptive transition with no dated bill, causal order, remedy, or replicate-weight standard errors; exit cell is smaller.
observations.counterinterpretation: Exit from reported foregoing may reflect changing need or access and does not establish financial recovery or care completion.

observations.period: 2024 to 2025; any listed cost-related care foregoing to any listed care foregoing

denominator.unit: recontacted respondents with complete E1_a-E1_e in both years

observations.method: Link 2024 and 2025 records by shedid; complete care fields in both years; any Yes among E1_a-E1_e defines foregoing; outcomes are 2025 values weighted by panel_weight.
observations.uncertainty: Longitudinal descriptive transition with no dated bill, causal order, remedy, or replicate-weight standard errors.
observations.counterinterpretation: Persistence may reflect ongoing illness, access, coverage, prices, or repeated unrelated needs; it is not a causal effect estimate.

reproduction_audit.result: A direct rerun reproduced the four care-path counts and published adaptation percentages; raw inputs remain outside the repository.
reproduction_audit.interpretation: This is an annual same-respondent descriptive transition, not a dated bill, causal, recovery, remedy, trust, or political-action estimate.

boundary: The panel transition does not establish the bill, need, amount, alternative, care continuity, payment timing, recovery, institutional remedy, trust, or political action.
